items.title: Apollo Is Vastly Outspending the Neoclouds on AI Chips
items.summary: Last week, SpaceX’s announcement that it would lease $40 billion worth of Nvidia Vera Rubin chips was a further signal of Elon Musk’s grand ambitions in the AI race. The deal also underscores the arrival of a new big player in that competition: Apollo Global Management, a 36-year-old private equity giant. In the deal with SpaceX, Apollo will purchase the chips through a subsidiary, then lease them to Musk’s company. The arrangement follows a supersized Apollo deal announced in June, one that also involves Broadcom and Blackstone, another large money management firm: a $35 billion fundraising for Apollo to buy Google’s tensor processing units and lease them to Anthropic.

news.title: AI Stocks Surge on Tuesday: AEHR, Fabrinet, and Lattice Semiconductor All Jump More than 10%
news.summary: Eric Bleeker of 24/7 Wall St. says the AI trade is showing life on Tuesday morning as a string of suppliers report strong results. The backdrop is rough: stocks in the technology, media and telecom momentum factor are down 62% from their 52-week high, a sharper correction than the dot-com bust, as hedge funds cut AI positions and money rotates into defensive areas like consumer staples. Shares of Aehr Test Systems (NASDAQ: AEHR) are up 22%. The company makes burn-in test equipment, and sales are expected to triple this year. Fabrinet (NYSE: FN) is up 13%, with CEO Seamus Grade saying optics demand looks very sustainable. That matters after Marvell Technology (NASDAQ: MRVL) announced a $115 billion buyout of Lumentum (NASDAQ: LITE), a deal that sent both stocks lower. Lattice Semiconductor (NASDAQ: LSCC) also rose 13% after revenue climbed 118%. Advanced Energy (NASDAQ: AEIS) gained 10% after earnings of $3.65 beat estimates of $3.04. Eaton (NYSE: ETN), a large supplier of electrical infrastructure for data centers, raised its full-year EPS targets and is up 7%. Bleeker's takeaway: earnings are beating expectations and point to 2027 being bigger than Wall Street expects, so watch the picks and shovels plays as earnings season continues.

news.summary_zh: 24/7 Wall St. 的 Eric Bleeker 指出，隨著一系列供應商公布強勁業績，AI 交易週二上午顯現出生機。背景艱難：科技、媒體和電信動能因子股票從其 52 週高點下跌 62%，回調幅度比網際網路泡沫破裂更劇烈，因對沖基金削減 AI 部位，資金輪動至消費性必需品等防禦性領域。Aehr Test Systems (NASDAQ: AEHR) 股價上漲 22%。該公司製造燒錄測試設備，銷售預計今年將增長三倍。Fabrinet (NYSE: FN) 上漲 13%，CEO Seamus Grade 表示光學需求看起來非常可持續。這在 Marvell Technology (NASDAQ: MRVL) 宣佈以 $115 billion 收購 Lumentum (NASDAQ: LITE) 後顯得重要，該交易導致兩檔股票下跌。Lattice Semiconductor (NASDAQ: LSCC) 在營收增長 118% 後也上漲 13%。Advanced Energy (NASDAQ: AEIS) 在盈利 $3.65 超過預估 $3.04 後上漲 10%。Eaton (NYSE: ETN) 作為數據中心電力基礎設施的大型供應商，上調全年 EPS 目標並上漲 7%。Bleeker 的結論：盈利超預期並指向 2027 將大於華爾街預期，因此隨著財報季持續，關注掘金者類股票。
